name: governance-review
description: Human spot-check of release-candidate answers: faithfulness, citation correctness, tone, and free-text notes. The human layer of the governance kit, next to the AnswerFaithfulness judge and the release-candidates-eval test set.

questions.title: Is the answer faithful to the evidence?
Are the citations correct and sufficient?

notes: Inputs for the Aria review_queue.create step (the same shape as POST /review-queues). In the plan's form, questions and reviewers are JSON arrays. Each question item is {key, title, type in [pass_fail, categorical, numeric, text], options (required for categorical), required, target in [feedback, expectation]}; only key and title are required per item. Aria does not enqueue traces unless you answer the review_queue.add_items form: there are no traces yet in this lab, so you Skip step on it. Strip this notes key before posting the file as inputs.
